lines: After all, they were just shady cosmetics peddlers.
With our strength, they were no match for us. However...
Perhaps they'd used some mist that contained something like a sleeping drug on Kirara-senpai, but she appeared to be asleep and was being taken away by the peddlers.
Get the hell outta here! Hurry! We've hit the jackpot!
We chased after them, but this was the downtown area, after all. There were too many people.
Not only that, but they knew this area.
The peddlers who'd taken Kirara-senpai pulled further and further ahead of us while pushing aside a crowd of people.
Hebiko, stop! If you use your ink in a place like this, it'll be even harder to find them!!
But even if you say that...! Ahhh, jeez, Hebiko's losing sight of her!!
She was gone. We had lost sight of Kirara-senpai amid the crowd.
No sooner did we set foot in Tokyo Kingdom had we found that my incident magnet was functioning perfectly...
